email_subject: Application - UI Design System & Information Architecture Internship
email_body:
Dear HMS Networks Team,

I am writing to apply for the UI Design System & Information Architecture Internship. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design and front-end development, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your global industrial platform's design system.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, build and maintain WordPress sites, and analyze performance data. My experience with AngularJS as a front-end developer at ViviDoctor and my ongoing coursework in applied computer science have given me a solid understanding of component-driven design and development workflows. I am particularly drawn to this role because it combines my interests in design systems, information architecture, and structured documentation.

I am curious, organized, and eager to learn from your senior Information Architect. I am comfortable navigating complex systems and am disciplined in following structured methodologies like Lean UX and SAFe. I am confident that my analytical skills and attention to detail will enable me to extract, structure, and synthesize information effectively.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core skills
- Frontend & design: AngularJS, JavaScript, responsive web design, component-based design, WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme
- Design systems & documentation: extracting guidelines, structuring information, documenting interaction patterns
- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
- Analytics & reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

### Warehouse & Logistics — Katoen Natie (Antwerp), 2025–2026
- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment
